missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Разведчик' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'вернулся', which agrees in masculine gender.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Разведчика' is the accusative direct object of 'поймали', and for an animate masculine noun the accusative copies the genitive. 'Нашего' agrees accordingly.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Разведчика' takes the genitive after 'у' in the possession frame, showing that the map belonged to the scout.
Strategic focus: Dative complement. 'Разведчику' is the dative governed by 'доверял'. 'Опытному' agrees in the masculine dative, expressing trust in the scout.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Разведчиком' is the instrumental governed by 'гордились'. 'Смелым' agrees in the masculine instrumental, naming the source of pride.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Разведчике' is the prepositional form after 'о'. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, marking the topic of conversation.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Разведчика' takes the genitive after 'без', meaning the squad would not move without the scout.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Разведчики' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural, describing the whole group.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. After 'двух' the animate noun takes the genitive plural form 'разведчиков', which also serves as the accusative object of 'отправил'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Разведчиком' is the instrumental required after 'стать', naming the role one aspires to become.
